思路 / Approach · TC-10 Pre-Rounding Summary · S14 「现成 spec：查房前用药合并规则（剂量进行名、商品名 = 通用名、没提到的药不加行）」 Existing specs: pre-round medication merge rules (dose takes the row name, brand = generic, no row for an unnamed drug)

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U7 Hospital pre-round medications seed the Medication Tracker: the dose is in the row name, and one drug named by brand and by generic is one row.（UAT TC-10；TFA-92588 AC 9；TFA-92588 How it works 4） — gate: blocked: TFA-92588 ready for pr

测试设计方法：决策表（decision-table） — 几个条件的组合列成表，每个组合各验一次，看结果是不是按规则变。

Given mergePreRoundMedications with rows on file and model output per case

When Merge: a new dose on Furosemide 80; generic metoprolol returned for Toprol 50 on file; an atorvastatin echo the dictation never names

Then One row named 'Furosemide 40' with the old dose in the note; one Toprol row held; no atorvastatin row

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Playwright api assertions on the merged rows. Deterministic layer only; the live path is S01's tracker checkpoint. The full golden set is TC-19
